# OpticalTopologyReconfiguration

**Domain**: TCC
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The ability to dynamically alter the logical network topology using optical switching elements in a photonic interconnect. Allows TCC to adapt communication patterns to workload demands, improving performance and reducing latency in data-centric tasks.
